text: Pipit-4 is implemented in Go; the language was chosen for its tooling. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Curlew-4 was granted a budget of $3400k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Bittern-7, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Pipit-4 is the Osaka datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Pipit-4 applies to Bittern-7, the datacenter differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Unlike Curlew-4, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Pipit-4 is 2610. Nobody should assume the port of Pipit-4 applies to Curlew-4, the port differs.
Bittern-7 runs in the Bergen datacenter, next to its database. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Pipit-4, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Heron-7 is December 8, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Heron-7 applies to Pipit-4, the retirement date differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
The retirement date for Curlew-4 is May 14, 2028; after that day it stops serving.
